narrative: On the part. A part open on the table at the window, the cue-line's end still in Latin, no strike through it. The hired bag is gone from the passage. On the part. The lines above the tag, crowded, written for a room. The stylus is not on the leaf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the unreformed cue and took it to the Theatre as it was.

entities.name: the comedy
entities.context: Shown on part in The tag, still Latin
